platform_outcome.lesson: Two compounding errors, both ground-truth-confirmed: (1) DUPLICATE — both credentials were previously reported (we cannot dedupe against others' private reports, so this is unavoidable noise, but the keys being old/well-known should have lowered prior). (2) IMPACT MISJUDGED — trufflehog Verified=true proved only that the ISSUER accepts the key, NOT that it carries security impact. Both keys are low/no-impact: a free-tier/test RPC key. The report inflated impact with speculative capabilities ('request interception', 'World ID proof interception', 'higher-privilege methods MAY also be available') that blockchain JSON-RPC keys do not grant. Blockchain RPC provider keys (Alchemy/Infura/QuickNode/etc.) are frequently public-by-design, free-tier, or test fixtures and grant at most rate-limit consumption against PUBLIC chains. See [[feedback-rpc-key-low-impact]] and rule-report_drafter-blockchain_rpc_key_severity_cap-7c4d9.
